official_run_sequence: Resolve and record exact public preregistration identity and manifest digest.
Verify official OPA binary SHA-256 before execution.
Run each shared fixture exactly once in published fixture order with concurrency 1.
Run the EHCO public proof kernel with a run-bound challenge nonce.
Run OPA against the same material request values using the frozen Rego policy.
Retain raw public-safe outputs and errors for both operands.
Emit one machine-readable comparison receipt accounting for every planned case.
Do not rerun or discard a failed/unfavorable case except through a new protocol version where the frozen invalid-run rule requires it.
pre_preregistration_qualification: Verify frozen OPA release tag/commit/asset identities.
Native OPA parse check of opa-reference.rego.
Native OPA evaluation of every frozen shared fixture as qualification-only output.
Exercise comparison harness failure accounting without designating any output an official comparative result.
Run exact-candidate disclosure qualification including provider-facing metadata.
result_publication_rule: Publish all planned case outcomes with equal fidelity, including EHCO failures, OPA advantages, ambiguity, unsupported cases, and environmental failures.
